comment: open fresh + write two + reopen (replays through root upd)
a freshly created log has zero messages
reopening replays and reports the two written messages
both messages were replayed through the root upd
the replayed message carried the correct table name
roll closes the current log and opens the next day's
the next day's log file exists after a roll
opening a corrupt log fails fast rather than partially replaying
replay repairs a corrupt log and processes each good message once
replay executed the root upd exactly once per recovered message (no double-processing)
check on a clean log returns the same file unchanged
replayupto replays only the first n messages (not later live-and-logged ones)
